terminal_topology.contact_join: Use /tmp/feed-v2-electrical-design.json nineteen-axis 57-degree solder-prism support and full wetted 4x4 cap; no old 3-degree adapter credit
terminal_topology.via_manufacturing: Filled/capped plated through via-in-pad required; 0.7mm centres make annuli tangent and leave 0.25mm copper-edge margin; supplier drill, annulus, cap, solder-wicking and 2oz clearances unqualified

In1.Cu.candidate: Retain continuous AGND zone clipped to source outline; three W4/W5/W6 via banks enter at distinct coordinates; explicitly preserve a connected top-band between all three via banks and the load-side AGND plane after antipads, with finite sheet cells and shared necks. F/B local AGND fill may help only after explicit via/contact proof.

In2.Cu.candidate: Add one explicit +5V zone polygon equal to inset source outline, clipped against all retained In2 signal tracks/pads/keepouts and other-net via antipads. W3 via bank is its injection port on each board; no historical +5 plane is claimed. Refill/project this new candidate-local polygon; require one positive connected component from W3 to every +5 load/bypass port. If clipping fragments it, report exact blocking obstacle/cut, do not bridge across signal or copy old global copper.

In3.Cu.candidate: Retain -12V fill around inner signals, clipped after all 300 new via barrels/antipads; W2 via bank is injection, every -12V load needs positive local transfer.

In4.Cu.candidate: Retain +12V plane with W1 via bank injection, clipped after all new via barrels/antipads; every +12V load needs positive local transfer.

F.Cu/B.Cu.owner: existing signals/local AGND plus face-specific new lands
F.Cu/B.Cu.candidate: KA new lands on B.Cu, KB on F.Cu. Do not move 18 legacy main lands. Count same-net cap-to-barrel spreading and any local jumper as finite copper. No solder support outside its 4x4 land.

layer_construction.anti_pad_rule: For each of 300 through barrels, on every non-target layer subtract a rule-clearance disk; verify inter-via merged voids do not sever any AGND/rail/+5 conductor or existing signal. Do not assign an unfilled zone electrical conductance.

KA.required_pin_binding: exact ref+pad+board+net and positive copper-component attachment; duplicate or omitted pin fails

KB.required_pin_binding: exact ref+pad+board+net and positive copper-component attachment; duplicate or omitted pin fails

algorithm: Enumerate all exact fitted supply pin and bypass-pair refs from sealed power contract; bind to one KA or KB native pad UUID/net. Keep original-K reference for reconciliation but never copy an object to both candidates.

For each net/board, begin with retained candidate-local copper and newly proposed one-net zone. Subtract exact native obstacle polygons/clearance and determine connected filled components; net-name equality alone is not an edge.

If an SMD load pad lacks direct same-net contact to its target zone, choose the first legal local via site on a deterministic 0.25mm grid within 2mm of that pad, with exact pad/track/drill/antipad clearance and a finite connecting local trace; if none exists, emit an exact ref/pad obstruction rather than a global route search.

For every load pin/bypass/return contact record its actual source pad UUID, candidate board, zone/track/via component, and unique path to a specific CS247 bank or KA main land; reject any unmatched, wrong-net or duplicate-owner item.

Build finite resistor cells for actual clipped polygons on 70um nominal 2oz copper, vias using layer-to-layer depth, local pads/neck and plated wall bounds; couple exact 12 wire contact fields and all signed GH/peripheral ports; solve worst-case node voltages/currents and return-open cases.
load_mapping.no_global_copy: The old 40 global K rail objects and mixed projection component are tracked by UUID below. The authenticated two-A fixture has zero rail tracks/vias and zero CS247 pads; its reached-object count is diagnostic only, not a cross-board copper budget.

historical_40_disposition.selection_rule: B-only or mixed seed geometry is reconstructed only for its exact B-owned load endpoint if needed; all 40 original UUIDs retain single candidate disposition. If an old segment/via cannot be represented on B without conflict, list its exact replacement and preserve terminal continuity. A uses new local conductor/access; never copy all reached objects to both boards.

finite_budget_screen.three_return_condition: If each of three independently contacted return bank-to-bank paths has the same finite two-port endpoints and <=0.5mOhm branch access budget, their parallel combination may be bounded without equal current sharing; shared plane neck and all multiport injections must be added/solved once.
finite_budget_screen.important_noncredit: 0.05176mOhm is a nominal ideal full-barrel comparison, not a hot/process bound. Pad spreading/cap/plane access and layer depths are additional. An uncut ideal full-plane width is not a source-to-load proof.

acceptance_tests: All12 exact terminal ref/pad/UUIDs and300 capped vias exist at these centres, correct face/net/layer, preserving fixed physical land positions and mask/courtyard. No same-net zero-ohm alias.
Every 40 historical source-object UUID has exactly one recorded B-rebuild/replacement or justified drop with equal endpoint proof; no A duplication and no unowned A load.
All exact KA/KB fitted supply pins, AGND contacts and bypass pairs bind to connected local copper, with no silently omitted +5V loads.
After exact clipping/fill, each of In1 AGND, In2 new +5, In3 -12 and In4 +12 has W-bank-to-all-owned-load continuity; copper/antipad/clearance and native DRC remain separate gates.

Finite hot current/potential-compatible board+contact+wire network meets 20mV, 1/0.5mOhm global budgets and every contact/wire current screen for signed normal and required return-loss cases; no equal sharing.
Carrier/insulation/strain/service travel through 10.1mm with 57-degree endpoint and drill/cap process capability separately qualified.
limitations: This is an actual candidate geometry/ownership algorithm, not a populated PCB or measured process. Large In2 +5 zone may be fragmented by retained signals; any exact cut is a falsifier, not permission to reassign layers or discard loads. No native or F3 trial was run.
